knowledge.name: Synthetic service-request snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed fictional requests record priority, type, zone, location, equipment, required certifications, estimated hours, and assignment status.

knowledge.name: Synthetic technician and zone records
knowledge.detail: Fixed technician skills, status, location, capacity, efficiency, and experience combine with geographic-zone load and staffing records.

knowledge.name: Dispatch rules and authorization controls
knowledge.detail: Bundled rules define filtering, priority order, capacity math, scoring, emergency selection, evidence anchors, and prohibited acts.

knowledge.name: Approved production connection seams
knowledge.detail: Dynamics 365 Field Service, an approved telematics feed, and a Microsoft Teams notification flow are documented but not connected.

intelligence_processing.name: Service-request queue triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Filters and prioritizes the synthetic request queue so managers can review critical, high, medium, and low work without changing jobs.

intelligence_processing.name: Zone load and capacity comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates open requests, total estimated hours, remaining job slots, and utilization for dispatcher review before any rerouting.

intelligence_processing.name: Skill-matched candidate scoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Requires all certifications and remaining capacity, then scores efficiency, zone fit, and availability to recommend a candidate for review.

intelligence_processing.name: Emergency response preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Identifies synthetic critical or emergency requests and lists certification-eligible responders in an approval-gated response draft.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-led operation routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps field manager, service director, dispatch coordinator, and emergency duty manager questions to one bounded read-only operation.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent exposes four independently routable operations through local Brainstem chat, streaming, and API surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language preview while the validated pilot remains Draft and unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first dispatcher review
clients_user_interface.detail: Responses lead with synthetic evidence, explain uncertainty, identify the authorized reviewer, and end with the no-write boundary.

management_reporting.name: Dispatch dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports prioritized requests, unassigned work, and available technicians while confirming no job, crew, route, or inventory changed.

management_reporting.name: Zone capacity review
management_reporting.detail: Presents staffing, open requests, total hours, remaining slots, and utilization for review of travel, safety, labor, and SLA constraints.

management_reporting.name: Technician candidate recommendation
management_reporting.detail: Shows the best certification-matched candidate, score, efficiency, and zone fit as a recommendation only; no technician is assigned.

management_reporting.name: Emergency response draft
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes the emergency, location, equipment, estimate, and eligible responders for approval without notification or field action.

tools.name: FieldServiceDispatchAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated pilot, four skills, and two knowledge files; the agent remains Draft and publication requires confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
tools.detail: Approved least-privilege production seam for field-service records; the current package has no live read or write connection.

tools.name: Approved telematics feed
tools.detail: Documented production seam for verified travel and location context; synthetic records are used until an approved connector exists.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams notification flow
tools.detail: Documented human-review and notification seam; the package does not send messages, request approvals, or notify technicians.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill evidence.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every organization, person, identifier, measurement, status, score, and recommendation is fictional pilot evidence, not a live fact.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Dispatch dashboard, route optimization, technician assignment, and emergency response remain independently callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed record handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown zones or request identifiers return no substituted records, and the agent does not browse or invent missing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Dispatcher review boundary
supporting_features.detail: A human dispatcher applies safety, labor, SLA, emergency, and authorization procedures before any operational decision.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous dispatch or side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never assigns, notifies, reroutes, or dispatches crews; changes jobs; contacts customers; stages inventory; or authorizes field action.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future-write pattern
supporting_features.detail: Any later write tool must be separate, authenticated, role-authorized, current-state validated, explicitly confirmed, and immutably audited.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed locked anchors; Copilot Studio validation and export do not authorize publication or production use.
